title: Ore Uranium
description: Tired of the same old ores? Uranium Expansion introduces a versatile and radioactive mineral that changes everything you know about survival. In this mod, Uranium isn’t just a resource—it’s a lifestyle.
body: This mod adds uranium to Minecraft. It is found in very deep caves and is rarer than diamonds. Uranium can be used to make tools, armor, uranium gunpowder, uranium sticks, and uranium TNT. Uranium must be smelted to make items. Raw uranium can be eaten and causes nausea.
